c74object.name: evi_lib.genexpr
c74object.digest:
evi_lib.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the "evieve" Package.
It is for using in a codebox or in another .genexpr file via the "require()" command.
By declaring require("evi_lib.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in the evi_lib.genexpr file.
The evi_lib.genexpr file also requires: evi_adaa.genexpr
evi_biquad.genexpr
evi_clip.genexpr
evi_crossovers.genexpr
evi_dynamics.genexpr
evi_overdrive.genexpr
evi_polyblep.genexpr
evi_rcfilters.genexpr
evi_reverb_library.genexpr
evi_saturators.genexpr
evi_svf.genexpr
